previous_statement: Verification of the amplified four-corner clauses. Define gamma_UU=T_U, gamma_VV=T_V and gamma_UV=gamma_VU=the unique zero maps between the zero source and target cross-corners, with gamma_jk,n=I_n tensor gamma_jk. For diagonal inputs, the extended C_out*t-isomorphism clauses for T_U,T_V give involution compatibility, compressed-product compatibility, diagonal compressed-unit approximation, and the two-sided norm bounds at every amplification. If any input is off-diagonal, its source corner is zero, so it and every relevant source product are zero; the corresponding target map and target products are also zero, making the same clauses exact. Dagger merely exchanges the two zero cross-corners, as ensured by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. Hence all four fixed maps share the single defect rho=C_cross*t. Together with node 1.6, this is exactly an amplified four-corner merging datum in the sense of def-four-corner-merging-datum.
new_statement: Reduction of the amplified four-corner verification to the unresolved diagonal-unit estimate. Define gamma_UU=T_U, gamma_VV=T_V and gamma_UV=gamma_VU as the unique zero maps, with gamma_jk,n=I_n tensor gamma_jk. Nodes 1.4-1.6 establish the fixed amplification families, involution compatibility, compressed-product compatibility, two-sided norm control, and source/target complementarity; every clause involving an off-diagonal input is exact because both corresponding corners are zero. For W in {U,V}, however, put u_W=Co^{A_R}_{P_W^R}(P_W^R), the unit of S^{A_R}_{P_W^R}. The extended C_out*t-isomorphism property gives only ||T_W(I_{B_W})-u_W||<=C_out*t, and the exact decomposition T_W(I_{B_W})-P_W^R=[T_W(I_{B_W})-u_W]+[u_W-P_W^R] shows that the desired diagonal-unit estimate additionally requires uniform control of ||u_W-P_W^R||. None of the registered definitions or allowed externals states such control. Consequently the previous assertion that nodes 1.4-1.6 already form an amplified four-corner merging datum was invalid; the datum cannot be concluded from the currently allowed inputs.
